description: Use for investment fund assets and net flows: equity, bond, mixed and PPK funds. Assets, purchases of units, redemptions and net flows of investment funds in Poland from monthly IZFiA data: whole market, fund groups (short-term bond, bond, equity, mixed, PPK, target date, absolute return, commodity, crypto assets, private market) with IZFiA profiles, bond funds by type, equity funds by region, net flows since January and over 12 months, and the finwire index finwire_fund_flows_index (12-month net flows as % of assets a year earlier). Amounts in PLN million. Informational data, not investment advice.
